# OpenAsset JavaScript SDK (openassetjs)

Complete API documentation for LLMs and developers.

## Overview

openassetjs is a TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for the OpenAsset REST API. OpenAsset is a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system designed for architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) firms.

## Installation

```bash
npm install openassetjs
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { OpenAssetClient, createClient } from 'openassetjs';

const client = new OpenAssetClient({
  domain: 'your-company', // or full URL: 'https://your-company.openasset.com'
  tokenId: 'your-token-id',
  tokenString: 'your-token-string',
  timeout: 30000, // optional, default 30s
});

// Or use factory function
const client = createClient({ domain, tokenId, tokenString });
```

## Authentication

Uses Token Authentication via the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: OATU <token_id>:<token_string>
```

Create tokens at: `{domain}.openasset.com/Page/AuthenticationTokens`

---

## Core Concepts

### Query Parameters (All Endpoints)

```typescript
interface QueryParams {
  limit?: number;           // Results per page (default: 10, use 0 for all)
  offset?: number;          // Skip N results for pagination
  textMatching?: 'contains' | 'exact' | 'wildcard';  // Text search mode
  orderBy?: string | string[];  // Sort field(s), append 'Desc' for descending
  displayFields?: string | string[];  // Only return specific fields
  filterBy?: FilterBy;      // Advanced AND/OR filtering (JSON)
  gridLimit?: number;       // Limit for grid field rows
  gridOffset?: number;      // Offset for grid field rows
}
```

### Text Matching Modes

- `contains` (default): Value appears anywhere in string
- `exact`: Value must match completely
- `wildcard`: Use `*` for fuzzy matching, `!` prefix for NOT, escape with `\`

### Advanced Filtering (filterBy)

```typescript
// OR filtering (array = OR)
const filterBy = [
  { name: '*test*' },
  { code: '*test*' }
];

// AND filtering (object keys = AND)
const filterBy = {
  name: '*building*',
  code: 'ABC*'
};

// Complex AND/OR
const filterBy = {
  '-or': [
    { name: '*test*' },
    { code: '*demo*' }
  ]
};

// Usage
const projects = await client.projects.list({ filterBy });
```

### Numeric/Date Operators

- `1-5`: Range (inclusive)
- `<5`, `<=5`: Less than
- `>5`, `>=5`: Greater than  
- `!5`: Not equal

### Pagination

```typescript
// Get paginated results
const { data, fullResultsCount, offset } = await client.files.list({
  limit: 100,
  offset: 0
});

// Auto-paginate all results
const allFiles = await client.files.getAll({ category_id: 1 });
```

### Response Headers

```typescript
interface ResponseHeaders {
  'X-Full-Results-Count'?: string;    // Total matching results
  'X-Display-Results-Count'?: string; // Results in this response
  'X-Offset'?: string;                // Current offset
  'X-Timing'?: string;                // Processing time
  'X-Username'?: string;              // Authenticated user
  'X-User-Id'?: string;               // Authenticated user ID
  'X-OpenAsset-Version'?: string;     // API version
}
```

---

## Resources

### Albums

Albums are collections of files that can be shared with users and groups.

```typescript
// List albums
const albums = await client.albums.list({
  user_id: 5,
  company_album: 1,
  shared_album: 1,
  remoteFields: 'user',  // Include owner's name
  limit: 50
});

// Get album with expansions
const album = await client.albums.get(123, {
  groups: 'all',     // Groups with access
  projects: 'all',   // Associated projects
  topics: 'all',     // Associated topics
  users: 'all',      // Users with access
  files: 'all',      // Files in album
  remoteFields: 'user'
});

// Create album
const newAlbum = await client.albums.create({
  name: 'My Album',
  description: 'Album description',
  company_album: 1,
  share_with_all_users: 1
});

// Update album
await client.albums.update(123, { name: 'New Name' });

// Add files to album
await client.albums.addFiles(123, [1, 2, 3]);

// Get files in album
const files = await client.albums.getFiles(123, { limit: 100 });

// Remove file from album
await client.albums.removeFile(123, 456);

// Remove multiple files
await client.albums.removeFiles(123, [456, 789]);

// Merge albums (combine into one)
await client.albums.merge(targetId, [sourceId1, sourceId2]);

// Delete album
await client.albums.delete(123);
```

**Album Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `description`, `code`
- `user_id` - Owner
- `company_album`, `approved_company_album` - Company-wide visibility
- `shared_album`, `share_with_all_users` - Sharing status
- `locked`, `all_users_can_modify` - Edit permissions
- `private_image_count`, `public_image_count`, `unapproved_image_count`
- `created`, `updated`

---

### Aspect Ratios (Read-Only)

```typescript
const ratios = await client.aspectRatios.list();
// Returns: { id, code: 'landscape'|'portrait'|'square', label }
```

---

### Categories

Categories organize files (e.g., "Projects", "Reference", "Staff").

```typescript
// List categories
const categories = await client.categories.list({ alive: 1 });

// Get category
const category = await client.categories.get(1);

// Update category
await client.categories.update(1, {
  name: 'Project Images',
  description: 'Images organized by project',
  default_rank: 5,
  default_access_level: 2,
  display_order: 1,
  alive: 1
});
```

**Category Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `code`, `description`
- `alive` - Enabled/disabled
- `projects_category` - Whether this category uses projects
- `default_rank`, `maximum_rank` - File ranking defaults
- `default_access_level` - 1=Public, 2=Private, 3=Restricted
- `display_order`, `updated`

### Data Integrations

Connect OpenAsset with external systems (Vantagepoint, Cosential).

```typescript
// List integrations
const integrations = await client.dataIntegrations.list();

// Get with expansions
const integration = await client.dataIntegrations.get(1, {
  expand: {
    fields: 'all',
    keywordCategories: 'all',
    projectKeywordCategories: 'all',
    employeeKeywordCategories: 'all'
  }
});

// Create
const newIntegration = await client.dataIntegrations.create({
  name: 'Vantagepoint Connection',
  address: 'https://vantagepoint.example.com/api',
  data_integration_type: 'vision',
  display_order: 1
});

// Update
await client.dataIntegrations.update(1, {
  alive: 1,
  name: 'Updated Name'
});

// Delete
await client.dataIntegrations.delete(1);
```

---

### Employees

Employee records with custom fields and project associations.

```typescript
// List employees
const employees = await client.employees.list({
  alive: 1,
  withHeroImage: 1,  // Include hero image ID
  limit: 100
});

// Get employee with expansions
const employee = await client.employees.get(1, {
  files: 'all',      // Associated files
  projects: 'all',   // Project associations with roles
  persons: 'all',    // Linked persons
  withHeroImage: 1
});

// Create employee
const newEmployee = await client.employees.create({
  first_name: 'John',
  last_name: 'Doe',
  code: 'JDOE001',
  // Custom fields by rest_code
  department: 'Engineering',
  title: 'Senior Engineer'
});

// Update employee
await client.employees.update(1, {
  first_name: 'Jane',
  title: 'Principal Engineer'
});

// Get files for employee
const files = await client.employees.getFiles(1, { limit: 100 });

// Update file display order
await client.employees.updateFileDisplayOrder(1, [
  { id: 10, display_order: 1 },
  { id: 11, display_order: 2 }
]);

// Associate files with employee
await client.employees.addFiles(1, [10, 11, 12]);

// Remove file association
await client.employees.removeFile(1, 10);

// Get project associations
const projects = await client.employees.getProjects(1);

// Get/update project roles (grid field)
const roles = await client.employees.getProjectRoles(1, 5);
await client.employees.updateProjectRoles(1, 5, {
  limit: 1,
  offset: -1, // -1 = add new row
  total: 0,
  rows: [{
    project_role: 'Lead Engineer',
    start_date: '20230101000000',
    end_date: '0',
    role_description: 'Project lead responsibilities'
  }]
});

// Delete employee
await client.employees.delete(1);
```

**Employee Properties:**
- `id`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `descriptor` (full name)
- `code` - Unique identifier
- `alive`, `created`, `updated`
- `hero_image_id` - When withHeroImage=1
- Custom fields appear as additional properties

---

### Fields

Custom field definitions for Files, Projects, and Employees.

```typescript
// List fields
const fields = await client.fields.list({
  field_type: 'project',           // 'image' | 'project' | 'employee'
  field_display_type: 'option',    // 'singleLine' | 'multiLine' | 'date' | 'boolean' | 'option' | 'suggestion' | 'fixedSuggestion' | 'grid'
  alive: 1,
  built_in: 0,
  required: 1
});

// Get field with dropdown values
const field = await client.fields.get(1, {
  fieldLookupStrings: 'all'
});

// Create field
const newField = await client.fields.create({
  name: 'Project Status',
  field_type: 'project',
  field_display_type: 'option',
  description: 'Current project status'
});

// Update field
await client.fields.update(1, {
  name: 'New Name',
  description: 'Updated description',
  display_order: 5,
  alive: 1
});

// Get dropdown/suggestion values
const lookupStrings = await client.fields.getFieldLookupStrings(1);
// Returns: [{ id, value, display_order }]

// Grid Columns (for grid fields)
const columns = await client.fields.getGridColumns(61);

// Create grid column
const column = await client.fields.createGridColumn(61, {
  name: 'Role',
  field_display_type: 'singleLine'
});

// Update grid column
await client.fields.updateGridColumn(61, 1, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  display_order: 2
});

// Delete grid column
await client.fields.deleteGridColumn(61, 1);

// Delete field
await client.fields.delete(1);
```

**Field Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `code`, `rest_code` - Identifiers
- `field_type` - 'image' | 'project' | 'employee'
- `field_display_type` - UI type
- `built_in`, `protected` - System fields
- `required`, `hero` - Validation/display
- `include_on_search`, `include_on_info` - Visibility
- `regex`, `regex_description` - Validation
- `value_order_by` - 'displayOrder' | 'name' | 'nameDesc'
- `cardinality`, `display_order`, `alive`

---

### Files

Digital assets (images, videos, documents).

```typescript
// List files with filters
const files = await client.files.list({
  category_id: 1,
  project_id: 5,
  access_level: 2,
  photographer_id: 10,
  copyright_holder_id: 3,
  user_id: 1,
  rank: '>3',                    // Numeric operators
  filename: 'exterior*',          // Wildcard matching
  created: '>=20230101000000',    // Date filtering
  uploaded: '20230101-20231231',  // Date range
  textMatching: 'wildcard',
  // Remote fields - include related data
  remoteFields: ['photographer', 'copyright_holder', 'project_code', 'project_name', 'category', 'user'],
  displayFields: ['id', 'filename', 'project_id', 'photographer'],  // Only these fields
  orderBy: 'project_display_order',
  limit: 100
});

// Get file with expansions
const file = await client.files.get(123, {
  fields: 'all',     // Custom field values
  keywords: 'all',   // Applied keywords
  albums: 'all',     // Albums containing file
  sizes: 'all',      // Available image sizes
  employees: 'all',  // Associated employees
  remoteFields: ['photographer', 'project_name']
});

// Get file with specific sizes
const fileWithSizes = await client.files.getWithSizes(123, [1, 2, 8]);
// or
const fileWithAllSizes = await client.files.getWithSizes(123, 'all');

// Generate image URL
const imageUrl = await client.files.getImageUrl(123, 8); // File ID, Size ID
// Returns: 'https://data.openasset.com/...'

// Create/Upload file (S3 direct upload)
const upload = await client.files.initiateUpload({
  category_id: 1,
  original_filename: 'photo.jpg',
  project_id: 5,                    // Required for project categories
  original_filesize: 1024000,       // Required for S3 upload
  part_size: 5242880,               // 5MB parts (optional)
  partNumbers: [1, 2, 3]            // Get presigned URLs for these parts
});
// Returns: { id, aws_presigned_urls: [{ url, part_number }] }

// Upload parts to S3, collect ETags, then complete:
await client.files.completeUpload(upload.id, {
  1: 'etag-from-s3-part-1',
  2: 'etag-from-s3-part-2'
});

// Get additional presigned URLs
const urls = await client.files.getPresignedUrls(123, [4, 5, 6]);

// Update file metadata
await client.files.update(123, {
  access_level: 2,
  caption: 'Building exterior',
  description: 'Main entrance view',
  photographer_id: 10,
  copyright_holder_id: 3,
  rank: 8
});

// Rotate file
await client.files.rotate(123, 90); // 0, 90, 180, 270

// Get/Update custom fields
const fields = await client.files.getFields(123);
await client.files.updateFields(123, [
  { id: 1, values: ['New Value'] },
  { id: 5, values: ['20230601000000'] }
]);

// Keywords
const keywords = await client.files.getKeywords(123);
await client.files.addKeywords(123, [10, 11, 12]);
await client.files.removeKeyword(123, 10);

// Albums
const albums = await client.files.getAlbums(123);

// Employees
const employees = await client.files.getEmployees(123);
await client.files.addEmployees(123, [1, 2]);
await client.files.removeEmployee(123, 1);

// Batch update display order
await client.files.updateProjectDisplayOrder([
  { id: 100, project_display_order: 1 },
  { id: 101, project_display_order: 2 }
]);

// Delete file
await client.files.delete(123);

// Batch delete
await client.files.deleteMany([123, 124, 125]);
```

**File Properties:**
- `id`, `filename`, `original_filename`
- `category_id`, `project_id`
- `caption`, `description`
- `access_level` - 1=Public, 2=Private, 3=Restricted
- `rank` - Quality rating
- `photographer_id`, `copyright_holder_id`, `user_id`
- `click_count`, `download_count`
- `contains_video`, `contains_audio`, `duration`
- `is_vr` - Panoramic/VR image
- `md5_at_upload`, `md5_now`
- `rotate_degrees`, `rotation_since_upload`
- `created`, `uploaded`, `updated`
- `replaced`, `replaced_user_id`
- `project_display_order` - Order within project
- Remote fields when requested: `photographer`, `copyright_holder`, `project_code`, `project_name`, `category`, `user`, etc.

**Size Info (when sizes expanded):**
- `id`, `width`, `height`
- `file_format`, `colourspace`
- `quality`, `x_resolution`, `y_resolution`
- `http_root`, `http_relative_path` - URL components
- `filesize`, `cropped`, `watermarked`

---

### Groups

User groups for permissions and sharing.

```typescript
// List groups
const groups = await client.groups.list({ alive: 1 });

// Get group with users
const group = await client.groups.get(1, {
  expand: { users: 'all' }
});

// Create group
const newGroup = await client.groups.create({
  name: 'Marketing Team',
  default_for_new_users: 0,
  expires: 0
});

// Update group
await client.groups.update(1, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  expires: 1,
  expiry_date: '20251231235959'
});

// Delete group
await client.groups.delete(1);
```

**Group Properties:**
- `id`, `name`
- `alive`, `hidden`
- `default_for_new_users`
- `expires`, `expiry_date`
- `protected`

---

### Keywords

File keywords organized by category.

```typescript
// List keywords
const keywords = await client.keywords.list({
  keyword_category_id: 5,
  name: 'exterior',
  textMatching: 'contains'
});

// Get keyword with files
const keyword = await client.keywords.get(1, {
  expand: { files: 'all' }
});

// Create keyword
const newKeyword = await client.keywords.create({
  name: 'Interior',
  keyword_category_id: 1
});

// Create multiple
const keywords = await client.keywords.createMany([
  { name: 'Kitchen', keyword_category_id: 1 },
  { name: 'Bathroom', keyword_category_id: 1 }
]);

// Update keyword
await client.keywords.update(1, { name: 'Updated Name' });

// Merge keywords (must be same category)
await client.keywords.merge(targetId, [sourceId1, sourceId2]);

// Delete keyword
await client.keywords.delete(1);
```

**Keyword Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `keyword_category_id`
- `updated`
- `dead_image_count`, `private_image_count`, `public_image_count`, `unapproved_image_count`

---

### Keyword Categories

Categories that group keywords.

```typescript
// List
const categories = await client.keywordCategories.list({
  category_id: 1  // Parent file category
});

// Create
const category = await client.keywordCategories.create({
  name: 'Building Type',
  category_id: 1
});

// Update
await client.keywordCategories.update(1, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  display_order: 5
});

// Merge (must be same parent category)
await client.keywordCategories.merge(targetId, [sourceId1]);

// Delete
await client.keywordCategories.delete(1);
```

### Projects

Projects organize files and have custom metadata.

```typescript
// List projects
const projects = await client.projects.list({
  alive: 1,
  code: 'PRJ*',
  name: '*building*',
  latitude: '>40',
  longitude: '<-73',
  withEmbeddedFields: 1,    // Include custom fields inline
  withEmbeddedKeywords: 1,  // Include keywords grouped by category
  withLocation: 1,          // Include lat/long
  withHeroImage: 1,         // Include hero image ID
  textMatching: 'wildcard',
  orderBy: 'nameDesc',
  limit: 50
});

// Get project with expansions
const project = await client.projects.get(18, {
  fields: 'all',            // Custom field values
  projectKeywords: 'all',   // Applied project keywords
  albums: 'all',            // Associated albums
  employees: 'all',         // Associated employees with roles
  files: 'all',             // Files in project (nested noun)
  withEmbeddedFields: 1,
  withLocation: 1,
  withHeroImage: 1
});

// Create project
const newProject = await client.projects.create({
  name: 'New Building Project',
  code: 'NBP-2024-001',
  code_alias_1: 'NBP001',
  name_alias_1: 'New Building',
  // Custom fields by rest_code:
  client_name: 'ACME Corp',
  project_status: 'In Progress'
});

// Update project
await client.projects.update(18, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  alive: 1,
  code_alias_2: 'ALIAS2'
});

// Update location
await client.projects.updateLocation(18, {
  latitude: 40.7128,
  longitude: -74.0060
});

// Get/Update custom fields
const fields = await client.projects.getFields(18);
await client.projects.updateFields(18, [
  { id: 1, values: ['New Client Name'] },
  { id: 3, values: ['20230601000000'] }
]);

// Project keywords
const keywords = await client.projects.getProjectKeywords(18);
await client.projects.addProjectKeywords(18, [10, 11]);
await client.projects.removeProjectKeyword(18, 10);

// Albums
const albums = await client.projects.getAlbums(18);

// Files
const files = await client.projects.getFiles(18, { limit: 100 });

// Employees
const employees = await client.projects.getEmployees(18);

// Employee roles
const roles = await client.projects.getEmployeeRoles(18, 5);
await client.projects.updateEmployeeRoles(18, 5, {
  limit: 1,
  offset: 0,
  total: 1,
  rows: [{
    project_role: 'Project Manager',
    start_date: '20230101000000',
    end_date: '0',
    role_description: 'Managing all project activities'
  }]
});

// Delete project
await client.projects.delete(18);
```

**Project Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `code`
- `name_alias_1`, `name_alias_2`, `code_alias_1`, `code_alias_2`
- `alive`, `deleted`
- `created`, `updated`
- `dead_image_count`, `private_image_count`, `public_image_count`, `unapproved_image_count`
- `location` - { latitude, longitude } when withLocation=1
- `hero_image_id` - When withHeroImage=1
- Custom fields appear as additional properties when withEmbeddedFields=1

### Searches (Saved Searches)

```typescript
// List saved searches
const searches = await client.searches.list({
  saved: 1,
  user_id: 5,
  company_saved_search: 1
});

// Get search with access info
const search = await client.searches.get(1, {
  groups: 'all',
  users: 'all'
});

// Create search
const newSearch = await client.searches.create({
  name: 'Recent Exteriors',
  search_items: [
    { code: 'category', ids: ['1'], exclude: 0 },
    { code: 'keyword.5', ids: ['10', '11'], exclude: 0, operator: 'OR' },
    { code: 'uploaded', values: ['>20230101000000'], exclude: 0 },
    { code: 'rank', values: ['>3'], exclude: 0 }
  ],
  saved: 1,
  share_with_all_users: 1
});

// Update search
await client.searches.update(1, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  locked: 1
});

// Execute search (get matching files)
const results = await client.searches.execute(1, {
  limit: 100,
  offset: 0
});

// Share with groups
await client.searches.shareWithGroups(1, [
  { id: 5, can_modify: 0 },
  { id: 6, can_modify: 1 }
]);

// Share with users
await client.searches.shareWithUsers(1, [
  { id: 10, can_modify: 1 }
]);

// Get access lists
const groups = await client.searches.getGroups(1);
const users = await client.searches.getUsers(1);

// Delete search
await client.searches.delete(1);
```

**Search Item Codes:**
- `album`, `project`, `category` - By ID
- `photographer`, `copyrightHolder`, `user` - By ID or string
- `created`, `uploaded` - Date with operators
- `caption`, `description`, `filename`, `originalFilename` - Text search
- `rank`, `size`, `width`, `keywordCount` - Numeric with operators
- `accessLevel`, `aspectRatio`, `colourspace`, `fileFormat` - By ID
- `popularFields` - Searches filename, caption, description, keywords
- `deleted` - Boolean
- `keyword.{category_id}` - Keywords by category
- `projectKeyword.{category_id}` - Project keywords by category
- `field.{field_id}` - Custom field values

---

### Sizes

Image size definitions (generated versions).

```typescript
// List sizes
const sizes = await client.sizes.list({ alive: 1 });

// Get size
const size = await client.sizes.get(8);

// Create size
const newSize = await client.sizes.create({
  postfix: 'thumb',
  file_format: 'jpg',
  colourspace: 'RGB',
  width: 150,
  height: 150,
  always_create: 1,
  quality: 85,
  x_resolution: 72,
  y_resolution: 72
});

// Update size
await client.sizes.update(8, {
  name: 'Thumbnail',
  description: 'Small preview image',
  use_for_contact_sheet: 1,
  use_for_power_point: 0,
  use_for_zip: 1
});

// Delete size
await client.sizes.delete(100);
```

**Size Properties:**
- `id`, `name`, `postfix`, `description`
- `width`, `height`, `quality`
- `file_format` - 'jpg' | 'png' | 'tiff' | 'gif' | 'webp'
- `colourspace` - 'RGB' | 'CMYK' | 'Grayscale'
- `x_resolution`, `y_resolution`
- `alive`, `protected`, `original`
- `always_create`, `crop_to_fit`
- `use_for_contact_sheet`, `use_for_power_point`, `use_for_zip`
- `is_video` - Video size definition

---

### Text Rewrites (Read-Only)

```typescript
const rewrites = await client.textRewrites.list();
// Returns: { id, text_match, text_replace, case_sensitive, preserve_first_letter_case }
```

### Topics

Topics categorize albums.

```typescript
// List
const topics = await client.topics.list();

// Get with albums
const topic = await client.topics.get(5, {
  expand: { albums: 'all' }
});

// Create
const topic = await client.topics.create({
  name: 'Featured Projects',
  display_order: 1
});

// Update
await client.topics.update(5, {
  name: 'Updated Name',
  display_order: 2
});

// Merge
await client.topics.merge(targetId, [sourceId1]);

// Delete
await client.topics.delete(5);
```

### Users

```typescript
// List users
const users = await client.users.list({
  alive: 1,
  valid: 1
});

// Get user with groups
const user = await client.users.get(5, {
  expand: { groups: 'all' }
});

// Create user
const newUser = await client.users.create({
  full_name: 'John Doe',
  username: 'jdoe',
  password: 'secure_password',
  email: 'jdoe@example.com',
  expires: 0
});

// Update user
await client.users.update(5, {
  full_name: 'Jane Doe',
  email: 'jane@example.com',
  expires: 1,
  expiry_date: '20251231235959'
});

// Delete user
await client.users.delete(5);
```

**User Properties:**
- `id`, `username`, `full_name`, `email`
- `alive`, `valid`, `hidden`, `protected`
- `invited` - Created via invitation
- `expires`, `expiry_date`
- `current_album_id` - Currently selected album
- `sso_provider_id` - SSO integration

## Advanced HTTP Client Access

For operations not covered by resource methods:

```typescript
const httpClient = client.getHttpClient();

// Raw GET request
const response = await httpClient.get<MyType>('/SomeEndpoint', {
  params: { limit: 100 },
  expand: { nested: 'all' },
  remoteFields: ['field1', 'field2']
});

// Raw POST request
const response = await httpClient.post<MyType>('/SomeEndpoint', {
  field: 'value'
});

// HEAD request (get count without data)
const { headers } = await httpClient.head('/Files');
const count = parseInt(headers['X-Full-Results-Count'] || '0');
```

---

## Error Handling

```typescript
import { OpenAssetError, BadRequestError, UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError } from 'openassetjs';

try {
  const file = await client.files.get(99999);
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
    console.log('File not found');
  } else if (error instanceof UnauthorizedError) {
    console.log('Invalid credentials');
  } else if (error instanceof ForbiddenError) {
    console.log('Access denied');
  } else if (error instanceof BadRequestError) {
    console.log('Invalid request:', error.message);
  } else if (error instanceof OpenAssetError) {
    console.log('API error:', error.message, error.statusCode);
  }
}
```

**Error Types:**
- `OpenAssetError` - Base error class
- `BadRequestError` (400) - Invalid request/parameters
- `UnauthorizedError` (401) - Invalid authentication
- `ForbiddenError` (403) - Access denied
- `NotFoundError` (404) - Resource not found
- `MethodNotAllowedError` (405) - HTTP method not allowed
- `ConflictError` (409) - Resource conflict (duplicate)
- `UnprocessableEntityError` (422) - Valid request but cannot process

---

## Best Practices

### Batching
- GET requests: Use `limit` up to 500 for Files, higher for other resources
- POST/PUT/DELETE: Batch up to 100-200 items per request
- File uploads: Max 3GB per batch

### Performance
- Use `displayFields` to reduce payload size
- Use `remoteFields` instead of separate API calls
- Use noun expansions (`files=all`) instead of nested requests
- Implement pagination for large datasets

### Rate Limiting
- Implement exponential backoff for retries
- Monitor `X-Timing` header for slow requests
- Use batch operations instead of individual requests
